purpose: Define edge before seeing clean v2.4 validation PnL. No component may be relaxed because a result fails. Equation-2 corrects an impossible calendar gate discovered before any clean PnL was observed: MNQ launched 2019-05-06, so fewer than 756 weekdays exist before the already-contaminated 2022-01-01 boundary. DQ1 freezes a vendor-data quarantine after Databento condition metadata was inspected but before any clean v2.4 PnL was executed.

equation.name: WEAKEST_LINK_ROBUST_EXPECTANCY
equation.certified_edge: DATA_CLEAN AND CLEAN_SCOPE_COMPLETE AND SAMPLE_OK AND TEMPORAL_OK AND ROBUST_EDGE_EXPECTANCY > 0 AND BREAK_EVEN_MARGIN > 0
equation.interpretation: The strategy only claims edge at the weakest surviving expectancy after uncertainty, friction, outlier-removal and calendar-concentration attacks.

clean_historical_scope.reason: Use the complete genuine MNQ history available before the known-seen 2022+ performance era. Do not substitute NQ, synthetic pre-launch MNQ, or cherry-picked subranges.

vendor_data_quality_quarantine.policy: A vendor date whose condition is not available is not scored directly and is also quarantined through the maximum causal historical lookback. Raw dataset bytes remain unchanged and frozen; only clean score evidence is excluded. Any newly observed non-available vendor-condition date not declared here requires review before the sealed run.
vendor_data_quality_quarantine.causal_basis: v2.4 established wick zones and exceptional single-swing grading use a maximum 40-calendar-day historical lookback; shorter dependencies include 25-day FVG context plus prior-day/prior-week references. Therefore same-day-only exclusion is insufficient.

known_seen_performance_ranges.reason: Aggregate MNQ strategy performance over this multi-year Databento era was already inspected before the v2.4 equation was frozen. It can support development/robustness diagnostics, but it cannot be called a fresh clean v2.4 OOS proof.

anti_overfit.clean_final_edge_requires: Complete genuine MNQ history from launch through 2021-12-31 with contaminated ranges and the frozen pre-PnL vendor-data quarantine excluded from score evidence, or future post-freeze evidence under a separately frozen future-evidence contract.
